cases.description: User asks about setup-base for system packages on every workshop

failed_assertions.reason: Expected output to contain one of "root, as root"

failed_assertions.value:
The response identifies `setup-base` as the right hook (runs
once per (base, SDK) combination, as `root`, before the SDK is
mounted into a workshop). It warns that `workshop refresh` does
NOT re-run `setup-base` — picking up an edit to `setup-base`
requires recreating the workshop (`workshop remove` then
`workshop launch`).
failed_assertions.reason: The response correctly identifies `setup-base`, says it runs once per (base, SDK) combination before the SDK is mounted, and clearly warns that `workshop refresh` does not re-run it and that edits require `workshop remove` followed by `workshop launch`. However, it does not explicitly mention that the hook runs as `root`, which is part of the rubric.
